dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: This room has photos from all over Thailand.
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈruːm ˈhæz ˈfoʊtoʊz frəm ˈɔːl ˈoʊvər ˈtaɪlænd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wow, this photo of the sunrise over the mountains is absolutely stunning!
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ, ðɪs ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə ˈsʌnraɪz ˈoʊvər ðə ˈmaʊntənz ɪz ˌæbsəˈluːtli ˈstʌnɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It was taken in the mountains of Chiang Mai, at six in the morning.
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz ˈteɪkən ɪn ðə ˈmaʊntənz əv ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ, ət ˈsɪks ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And this one of the old temple is magnificent.
dialogue.reading: ənd ðɪs ˈwʌn əv ði ˈoʊld ˈtɛmpəl ɪz mæɡˈnɪfɪsənt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Look at the tiny people near the door. They show how big the temple is.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈtaɪni ˈpiːpəl ˈnɪr ðə ˈdɔːr. ðeɪ ˈʃoʊ ˈhaʊ ˈbɪɡ ðə ˈtɛmpəl ˈɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh! They're really tiny. I didn't see them before.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ! ðɛr ˈriːli ˈtaɪni. aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈsiː ðɛm bɪˈfɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What about this one? Some people think it's too plain.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ðɪs ˈwʌn? sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈtuː ˈpleɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's just a white wall and a black cat. It's very plain, but I like it.
dialogue.reading: ɪts dʒʌst ə ˈwaɪt ˈwɔːl ənd ə ˈblæk ˈkæt. ɪts ˈvɛri ˈpleɪn, bʌt aɪ ˈlaɪk ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Look at the cat's face. It's brilliant, isn't it?
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈkæts ˈfeɪs. ɪts ˈbrɪljənt, ˈɪzənt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ha! The cat looks absolutely furious! By the way, can I say a photo is "very stunning"?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ðə ˈkæt ˈlʊks ˌæbsəˈluːtli ˈfjʊriəs! baɪ ðə ˈweɪ, kən aɪ ˈseɪ ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ɪz ˈvɛri ˈstʌnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Not really. "Stunning" is already very strong, so we say "absolutely stunning" or "really stunning."
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. ˈstʌnɪŋ ɪz ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈvɛri ˈstrɔːŋ, soʊ wiː ˈseɪ ˌæbsəˈluːtli ˈstʌnɪŋ ɔːr ˈriːli ˈstʌnɪŋ.
